_comment: OHMSTEAD - the machine behind the Gateway. A black void and a glowing grid floor (art.entities.ground.render 'grid': GridGround, one shader), everything on it a bright outline, visitors redrawn as linework (art.actor_look.wire). Seven regions: the Inlet (where you arrive), the Arcade, the Cache, the Bus, the Heap, Clock Court and the Dark Sector. 'runners': closed routes little mint runners follow, a pure function of time. 'circuits': the ribbon boards (CircuitBoard / CircuitDirector on the client, Server.Circuit on the server): 'sector' is the secret's (reveal type 'circuit'), 'table' and 'today' are the Arcade's. Generated by tools/gen_ohmstead_world.py (art: gates-of-elyra/tools/gen_ohmstead.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Behind the scenery, where the worlds are drawn. The light on these lines keeps every other place lit. One patch of it has gone dark.

props.label: a welcome terminal
props.lore: Green letters, patiently scrolling. 'OHMSTEAD. You are behind the scenery now. Every world you have walked in is drawn from here, one line at a time, and the light on these lines is what keeps them lit. You look different because this is how the machine has always seen you. It likes your hat. The Arcade is east of here. North-east, a sector has lost its power: if you find it, tap a node and see what your companion does.'

props.label: the clock
props.lore: Rings of light, and a thin beam going straight up out of them into the dark. Once every little while a pulse runs up it, and when it does, every line in Ohmstead brightens very slightly, as if the whole place had breathed in.

props.label: the Arcade's sign
props.lore: ARCADE, in small bright capitals. Underneath, smaller: 'One ribbon. Every node. End on the white one. Nobody is keeping score but you.'

props.label: a sign: TODAY
props.lore: TODAY. 'This board is new each day, and it is the same board for everyone who comes. Once it is closed it stays lit until the day turns, so whoever arrives later can see it was done.'

props.label: a fault terminal
props.lore: Red letters this time. 'SECTOR 7: NO POWER. Cause: the loop is open. Remedy: one unbroken ribbon from the live line (amber mark) through every node to the outlet (white mark). A ribbon may not cross itself. Runners cannot do this. Runners carry. Something would have to lay it, node by node, on its own four feet.'

props.label: a terminal in the Heap
props.lore: 'THE HEAP. Everything the worlds are not using right now is kept here: a pine nobody is standing under, a hill nobody is looking at. They wait as outlines. It does not seem to bother them.'

props.label: a terminal in the Cache
props.lore: 'THE CACHE. Things that were wanted a moment ago and will be wanted again in a moment. A door's creak. The exact colour of a certain pond at dusk. Please do not rearrange them.'

props.label: a terminal by the Bus
props.lore: 'THE BUS. The widest lines in Ohmstead, running west to east. The runners use them for the long hauls. If one stops in front of you it is only waiting for you to pass. They are very polite, and a little shy.'

props.label: a relay tower
props.lore: A lattice tower with a little dish. It hums one note, slightly flat. Your companion tilts its head at it.

props.label: a relay tower
props.lore: Another relay, pointed at the first one, far to the west. Whatever they are saying to each other, they have been saying it for a long time.

props.label: a house of lines
props.lore: A little house made of nine lines. The door is the only warm thing about it, and it is very warm. Somebody, or something, lives here and has left the light on for you.

props.label: a house of lines
props.lore: A cabin, all edges. You can see straight through the walls to the other walls. There is a kettle in there, also made of lines.

props.label: a house of lines
props.lore: A house the machine drew and then kept. The door glows amber. On the step, a tiny cube, like a parcel nobody has collected.

props.label: a red marker
props.lore: A red marker, blinking slowly. It stands at the edge of the ground that has no power.

lines.near_sector: This patch of the grid has no power. Its lines are cold, and the runners go the long way round.
lines.near_arcade: The Arcade. Each board wants one ribbon of light through every node. Tap a node to send your companion.
lines.first: The ribbon starts where the live line comes in: tap the node with the amber mark.
lines.start: Your companion picks up a charge from the live line. Tap the next node along a line, and it carries the ribbon there.
lines.laid: The ribbon follows it. Every node needs to be lit, and the ribbon has to end on the white outlet.
lines.not_line: It can only run straight along a line, to a node the ribbon hasn't touched.
lines.bird: A bird flies over the board and lays nothing. The ribbon needs feet on the lines.
lines.stuck: The ribbon has nowhere left to go. Tap a lit node to wind it back to there.
lines.cleared: Your companion comes to you, and the ribbon goes out.
lines.let_go: Your companion leaves the ribbon where it is and comes to walk with you.
lines.other: Someone else's ribbon. Tap the next node from its bright end, and yours carries it on.
lines.closed: The board closes, and every node holds its light.
lines.dealt: A new board lights up on the table.
lines.today_done: Today's board is closed. A new one comes with the new day.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Ohmstead'). reveal.type 'circuit': the board named by reveal.board (in 'circuits') has to be closed, one ribbon through every node from its source to its sink, laid by a companion node by node; then the prop appears at 'position'. The board's state is shared and server-authoritative (Server.Circuit), so unlike most reveals the server CAN check it: a claim is honoured only while that board is closed, here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: One small spark, holding perfectly still in the middle of the lit board. Everything else here flickers a little. This doesn't. Your companion puts its nose very near it, and its outline goes a shade warmer.

reveal.dark_line: The sector's power fades again, and the spark goes out with it. Close the loop once more and it will be back.
reveal.lit_line: Someone closed the loop here a little while ago: the sector is lit, and in the middle of the board something small and steady is waiting.
reveal.reveal_line: The last node takes the light. Power runs back across the sector line by line, and in the middle of the board something small and steady is waiting.

secret.found_line: The loop is closed, and the machine has one fewer thing to worry about. The spark that held it goes home with you.

keepsake.label: a steady spark in a jar
keepsake.line: A spark in a little glass jar, not flickering. Your companion likes to lie where its light falls and watch it not move.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
